# Fictional Office renderer fixtures

`preview.docx`, `preview.xlsx`, `preview.pptx` and `preview.xls` are small,
fictional DeskSuite test documents generated by
`tools/generate_office_preview_fixtures.py`. They contain no real customer,
person or business data. They exercise word text/table, multiple sheets and
multiple slides; they are not examples of every Office feature or a fidelity
benchmark. The generator's Python packages are development-only and not app
runtime dependencies. The repository licence applies to these project-created
test files.

These fixtures do not cover legacy DOC or PPT. The optional upstream test set
specified in `docs/engineering/OFFICE_SUPPORT.md` covers one real file of each
of those formats, plus encrypted and OpenDocument inputs; its redistribution
licence is not stated, so it is not bundled here.
